extension.summary: Real fanart backgrounds for the currently playing music artist
extension.description: Lightweight replacement for Artist Slideshow. Looks up TheAudioDB / fanart.tv / Deezer for the currently playing artist and exposes the result via Window(Visualisation).Property(ArtistSlideshow.Image), compatible with the existing Aeon Nox 5 MusicVisualisation.xml patch. Runs as a proper Kodi background service (started once at Kodi startup) instead of a re-invoked script, avoiding the stuck/zombie "already running" issue.
extension.news: 1.4.0: fixed the artist fanart rotation permanently freezing on one image - Rotator.run() had no exception handling, so any single unhandled error (e.g. a stale path from a race with a fresh download) silently killed the rotation thread for the rest of the Kodi session. Now logs and keeps looping instead. 1.3.0: fixed addon settings showing values with no labels at all (blank rows) - the settings.xml used inline text for each setting's label instead of a numbered string ID resolved via strings.po, which this Kodi build silently fails to render for addon settings. Added a proper resources/language/resource.language.en_gb/strings.po and pointed each setting's label at its string ID, matching how the other working addons in this repo do it. 1.2.0: fixed a real bug - xbmc.Player().getPlayingFile() returns a musicdb://songs/... virtual URL (not a real path) when a track is played from the Kodi music library view, which silently broke library-folder saving (it always fell back to the private cache instead). Now resolves the real on-disk path via Player.GetItem's "file" property first. 1.1.0: added Deezer as a third image source (no API key needed) - mainly helps Slovak/Czech and other regional artists that TheAudioDB/fanart.tv don't have at all. Added an on-screen "searching for fanart..." notification on first fetch for a new artist, so it's clear something is happening during the initial download delay. 1.0.0: initial release.
